Held: evaluate the omitted known seed using the other two; New: the same existing new cases under each fit. Outside: norm >.10 m.
NA*: a represented mode has no training fit; keep the whole conditional result undefined. NA: empty population/retention. u counts unsupported references.
Both cohorts were observed previously. Repeated new evaluations are sensitivity checks, without independent replication or calibrated error guarantees.
